title: Set app domain to Cutiepie (frontend config)

requirements.summary: Configure the app/domain name as "Cutiepie" in frontend-visible configuration and ensure it passes the domain validation rules used by the app during startup.
acceptanceCriteria: The configured app domain is exactly "Cutiepie".
Domain validation passes (contains only letters, numbers, and hyphens; length 5–50).
A publish/deployment run completes successfully without domain validation errors.

file_operations.description: Create a single source of truth for the app/domain string set to "Cutiepie" along with a small validator enforcing: 5–50 chars, only letters/numbers/hyphens, and no underscores.

Import the app/domain constant and validation helper; validate on startup (fail fast with a clear console error if invalid) and set document.title to "Cutiepie" so the published app reflects the configured domain name.
Update the static <title> to "Cutiepie" to match the configured app/domain name for environments where JS is disabled or before hydration.
